AGENDA
  AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING – 633 E Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to the Glendale Audit Committee Meeting. If you have any agenda related questions or requests for assistance,
call the Finance Department at (818) 548-2085 during business hours. Audit Committee Meetings are archived and
available for viewing on the City’s website at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. Audit Reports are
available for viewing on the following link: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/departments/innovation-performance-
and-audit/audit-reports.

PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE HEARING ROOM.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation,
and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At
least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All
documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
are public records, will be available for review in the City Clerk’s Office at 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA
91206.

Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize the service
as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-2090, at least 24 hours
prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  January 28, 2019

1.  Roll Call:  8:10 a.m.

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian (absent),
  Thomas O’Shaughnessy, Alex Parajon and Vahik Satoorian (absent)

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary re: Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of January 28, 2019 was posted on
  Thursday, January 24, 2019 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  Minutes of the Special Audit Committee meeting held on Monday,
  October 29, 2018

  Minutes of the Special Audit Committee meeting of October 29, 2018 are carried over to the
  next meeting since there is no quorum of members who were present at the last meeting to
  approve them.

5.  ACTION ITEMS

  None

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION

  A.  Internal Audit Activity Report as of December 31, 2018 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager introduced the presentation of the two completed
  audit projects during the quarter ended December 31, 2018.
 Audit Committee Minutes
January 28, 2019

  Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor presented the Refuse Collections Revenue
  Audit. Internal Audit concluded that the billing process can be improved with the
  implementation of stronger controls.

  Mr. Dan Hardgrove, Assistant Director of Public Works was present and answered questions
  from the Committee members.

  Ms. Ani Antanesyan, Internal Auditor presented the Administrative Citations Audit. Internal
  Audit observed a general trend of higher code enforcement case compliance rates since the
  implementation of the administrative citation process, and that the warning notice component
  of the tool appeared to be the most effective at reaching quicker compliance.

  Ms. Zhang concluded her presentation by providing updates on the remaining projects and
  four outstanding audit issues based on the criteria set by the Audit Committee in Resolution
  #2. The outstanding issues are from the audit titled, Grant Administration Limited Review.
  With the implementation of the Tyler Munis financial accounting system, and the utilization of
  the grant management tools, the Finance Department will finalize the citywide grants policy
  and thus address these issues.

  B. Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) and Report to the Audit
  Committee from Vavrinek, Trine, Day & Co. LLP – Shu-Jun Li, Deputy Director of
  Finance

  Ms. Shu-Jun Li, Deputy Finance Director introduced Mr. David Showalter, Partner with
  Vavrinek, Trine, Day & Co., LLP (VTD), the City’s external Auditor. Mr. Showalter made a
  presentation to the Audit Committee and answered questions regarding the City’s fiscal year
  ended June 30, 2018 Audit.

  Mr. Bob Elliot, Finance Director said that the City Council voted to bring back VTD for a 6th
  year due to the implementation of the new Financial Software. However, next year an RFP
  will be issued for the selection of an External Auditing firm and one member of the Audit
  Committee will be involved with this process.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS

  Chair Amirian thanked staff and VTD for the tremendous amount of work they have put
  in to produce the CAFR. He specifically acknowledged the great amount of information,
  accountability and transparency in the document.

8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  Chair Amirian asked if the Audit Committee can start meetings without the City
  Attorney’s representative being present. Ms. Varpetian responded that yes, the Audit
  Committee meetings can start without their presence, as long as there is a quorum.

9.  ADJOURNMENT

  Moved: Alex Parajon  Second: Thom O’Shaughnessy

  Adjournment at 9:45 a.m.
